verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents the Storage Write API (gRPC) for streaming records in real time, with exactly-once delivery semantics. It also documents Pub/Sub BigQuery subscriptions for real-time streaming that loads data as it is generated, and continuous queries for analyzing incoming data in real time. The core of a documented streaming ingestion API is clearly present. missing for 10: explicit documented data-freshness or query-visibility latency ("within seconds") for streamed rows, independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming-to-query latency.
